messages.displayText:
These smartphones have a Pokémon called <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Rotom<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> living
in them. They float in midair under their own power,
leaving your hands free for other tasks.

This metropolis is the crown jewel of the Kalos region.
The entire city is laid out in one great circle, with the
inspiring <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Prism Tower<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> standing tall in its very center.
Reaching the Top of the Z-A Royale

Trainers who reach <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Rank A <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>in the Z-A Royale will be
recognized as the strongest Trainers in the city and may
have one wish granted by the tournament’s organizers.

A large corporation driving the <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>urban redevelopment plan<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
of Lumiose City in tandem with the local government.
They have a massive building in the Magenta District.

Widely known as the symbol of Lumiose City. The
observatory level was previously open to visitors but is
currently off-limits due to ongoing <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>renovations<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

These crystal clusters are thought to form when lots of
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Mega Power<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> accumulates. Officials ask that they be
smashed whenever found to keep the city pristine.

This phenomenon can occur when Pokémon take in
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>excessive amounts of Mega Power<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. This condition puts
a dangerous amount of strain on the Pokémon’s body.

Your Mega Ring has an embedded <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Key Stone<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> that lets it
channel the power of Mega Evolution by amplifying the
bonds between you and your Pokémon.

A group of young people entrusted with looking after
Lumiose by AZ, the first owner of Hotel Z. The team may
be small, but it includes <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>amazing Trainers<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

The fan club of the popular streamer, Canari. This group
is managed by her grandfather, Tarragon. Apparently
Canari’s fans like to refer to themselves as <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Canatics<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

A group that aims to train and empower people to protect
themselves. They act as a sort of volunteer defense force.
Many join simply because <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>they admire Ivor<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

A group that aims to help Lumiose grow and prosper.
Some accuse them of coercing people into <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>unpaid labor<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>,
while others argue it’s basically just community service.

A group of wealthy elites who believe they should use
their influence to make the world better. They seek not
only victory but also <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>beauty in battle<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

A group established by people with ties to the defunct
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Team Flare<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. They aim to give aid to those who need it,
such as by providing meals at their food trucks.

A detective agency founded by a man known as Looker—
though of course <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>that was only a code name<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. The bureau
is currently being run by his successor, Emma.

This tower looks very different without its cladding. The
day it reclaims its <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>former glory<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> will probably mark the end
for one phase of Lumiose’s urban redevelopment plan.

Press <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0006>Cancel<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> to <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>dash<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. There’s no need to hold the button
down—you will continue to dash as long as you keep
moving.

When you focus on a wild Pokémon with <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0002>ZL<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, note the
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>∧ icons<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> that appear. The more of these icons you see, the
easier of a time you’ll have catching that Pokémon.

You can crouch by pressing <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0007>Stick_L<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. Crouching down in tall
grass or behind obstacles can help <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>hide your presence<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
and make you harder to spot.

Press <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0005>Minus <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>to open your Rotom Phone’s camera app. If you
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>hold down<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0005>Minus <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>while opening the app, you’ll jump straight
to selfie mode.

Press <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0004>Sp_1<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> to open the <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>main menu<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. From this menu,
you can easily see how your party is doing, use items,
and more.

Press <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0001>L <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>from the main menu to open the Help &
Settings menu. You can check the game’s controls,
review tips, and <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>change certain settings<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

If you select a Pokémon in your Boxes, you can choose to
give it a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>nickname<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. You can change nicknames as many
times as you like if you’re the Pokémon’s original Trainer.

You can earn <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>valuable rewards<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, including TMs, by helping
out with Mable’s research. New research requests will be
added from time to time.

When you have the Z-A Royale app open, you can press
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0004>Sp_2<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> to <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>retake your profile picture<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. Express yourself with a
photo that tells your opponents who they’re up against!

Check out the effects, power, and other qualities of new
moves your Pokémon learn, then decide which ones to
set as the <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>current moves<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> they can use.

You can trade Pokémon with friends over the internet or
by using local communication. Pokémon that you receive
from others will <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>level up faster<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

Some items have particular effects when <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>held by a<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Pokémon<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. Choose the best item for your Pokémon by
reading each item’s description.

Some items, such as <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Pretty Feathers<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> and <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Tiny<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Mushrooms<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, can be sold for a decent amount of cash.
Sell them when you’re low on funds.

Pokémon Centers, cafés, and the like will be registered as
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>travel spots <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>on your map once you’ve visited them.

You may find <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>obstructions<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> around the city, such as
boulders or brambles, left by Pokémon activity. Some
can’t be removed unless you use certain moves on them.

<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Alpha Pokémon<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> are unusually large for their species.
What’s more, they always know one move that their
species doesn’t normally learn on its own.

Simply owning a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Canari plush<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> can grant you benefits,
such as improving your chance of success in catching
wild Pokémon. You can get them at Racine Construction.

Obtain <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Mega Shards<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> by smashing clusters of Mega
Crystals around town. The receptionist at Quasartico Inc.
will give you Mega Stones in exchange for these shards.

It’s said that taking time to relax with your Pokémon at
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>cafés<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> will not only restore their HP but also strengthen
your bonds with them.

If you give a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Seed of Mastery<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> to Josée at the Justice
Dojo, she can upgrade one of your Pokémon’s moves so
that it can be used as a Plus Move.

Different Pokémon can appear at night than during the
day. If you’re having trouble finding a particular species,
you might try looking for it during <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>a different time period<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

If you want to level up your Pokémon, defeating Trainers
in <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>battle zones<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> is the most efficient way to do so.

If you throw a Poké Ball at a wild Pokémon and miss,
worry not! A kindly <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>lost Poké Ball collector<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> will pick up
any such balls you lose.

If you <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>strike a Pokémon from behind<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> with a Poké Ball,
you’ll have a better chance at catching it. This technique
is sometimes known as a back strike.

The Stone Emporium on Vernal Avenue sells <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Mega<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Stones<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> and a variety of other stones, such as Evolution
stones.

Hailing a taxicab is a quick way to travel directly to <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>places<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>you haven’t visited before<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. Plus, you get to enjoy gossip
from Lumiose’s knowledgeable cab drivers.

You can easily <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>kill free time<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> by sitting on one of the many
benches around Lumiose City. You’ll always find them
beside Pokémon Centers as well as in other areas.

You can get your Pokémon’s stats trained intensely at the
Justice Dojo. Just be aware that this service requires
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Bottle Caps<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, a rare and precious item!

If you hit a Pokémon over and over with Poké Balls, it may
grow enraged. The Pokémon <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>can’t be caught<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> while it’s in
this state.

When your Pokémon learn moves via TM, they <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>won’t be<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>able to master those moves on their own<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. Josée of the
Fist of Justice can help upgrade these into Plus Moves.

If a Trainer takes too many hits from wild Pokémon, they
will <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>black out<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. If you think you may be in danger, the wise
course of action is to run away.

Select a Pokémon from your party by using <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+000B>Button_Left <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>or <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+000C>Button_Right<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.
Then press <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊	Button_Up<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> to <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>switch<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> it into battle.  Choosing the right
Pokémon will be key to victory.

The higher a Pokémon’s <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Speed <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>is, the sooner it will be
able to use moves—in other words, this stat shortens the
cooldown time between moves.

Moves that are classified as <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>physical<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> hit harder if the user
has a high Attack stat. But they do less damage if a target
has a high Defense stat.

Moves that are classified as <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>special<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> hit harder if the user
has a high Sp. Atk stat. But they do less damage if a
target has a high Sp. Def stat.

Moves that are classified as <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>status<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> moves can have a
range of effects, such as temporarily boosting your own
stats or imposing some disadvantage on your opponents.

Using multiple moves that temporarily boost the same
stat will not make the stat boost more powerful. It will,
however, make the stat boost <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>last longer<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

Pokémon that become <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>confused<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> will behave strangely.
However, they will recover automatically after a short
amount of time.

If a Pokémon becomes <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>drowsy<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, its moves will have longer
cooldown times. This condition can be healed by using
an Awakening.

If a Pokémon becomes <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>paralyzed<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, its movement speed
will be slowed. This condition can be healed by using a
Paralyze Heal.

A <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>poisoned<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> Pokémon will lose HP over time. If it’s <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>badly<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>poisoned<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, the amount of HP it loses will increase over
time, too. Use an Antidote to heal from poisoning.

A <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>burned<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> Pokémon will gradually lose HP over time, and
the power of its physical moves will be weakened. A burn
can be treated by using a Burn Heal.

A <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>frozen<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> Pokémon will be unable to move for a certain
period of time. Use an Ice Heal to thaw it out.

Press <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0004>Plus<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> before choosing a move to use the move as a
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Plus Move<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. Plus Moves use up a little Mega Power but
have increased power and areas of effect.

A supereffective <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Plus Move<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> will deal even greater damage
than a regular move that is super effective.

If you use a status move as a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Plus Move<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, it will gain an
improvement that depends on the move chosen. For
example, some moves might have their effects last longer.

Moves like <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Protect<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> or <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Detect<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> can defend a Pokémon from
an opponent’s attack. However, moves like these cannot
stop a Plus Move.

Mega-Evolved Pokémon use moves as Plus Moves by
default—even <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>ones they haven’t yet mastered<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.
The Power in Your Mega Ring

Your Mega Ring gains <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Mega Power<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> every time you order
your Pokémon to use a move. The closer you’re standing
to your Pokémon, the more Mega Power you’ll gain.
Type Matchups with Rogue Mega-Evolved Pokémon

A Rogue Mega-Evolved Pokémon’s moves are extremely
powerful. Even attacks that would normally have no effect
on your Pokémon’s type will <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>still deal some damage<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

During battle, you can press <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0004>Sp_1 <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>to open your menu and
use Potions and other items. After you use an item in
battle, <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>you’ll have to wait a while before using another<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

You <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>won’t be able to select a travel spot<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> from your map
while battling a wild Pokémon. Make sure you’re in a safe
location before making use of travel spots.

If an opponent <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>senses your presence<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> in a battle zone,
you’ll be dragged into a battle. Move quietly to avoid
being noticed!

<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Trainers of higher rank than you<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> in battle zones will often
try to initiate battles by catching you off guard.

In battle zones, <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>the higher your opponent’s rank<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, the
more prize medals you’ll gain from defeating them.

When your prize medals are tallied up at the end of a
night, you’ll receive a bonus based on <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>how many Trainers<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
you defeated in that night’s battle zone.

Occasionally, a bonus card will be <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>special<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, providing an
easy windfall. Look for cards with shining point numbers.

Some opponents in battle zones will give you a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>reward<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
or heal your Pokémon after you defeat them.

Pokémon found in Hyperspace Lumiose have a very high
temporary level known as its hyperspace level. If you
catch such a Pokémon, <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>its level will return to normal<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

These pockets of Hyperspace Lumiose contain <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>wild<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Pokémon<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> that you may not find living in Lumiose City,
providing a chance to meet some rare Pokémon.

These pockets of Hyperspace Lumiose resemble <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>battle<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>zones<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. The hyperspace level phenomenon appears to
boost the levels of opposing Trainers’ Pokémon here.

If you use a donut with a star ranking that’s below the
ranking of the hyperspace distortion you’re entering,
you’ll have a much <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>harder time catching Pokémon<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> there.

The higher the rank of a pocket of hyperspace, the faster
Hoopa will <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>burn through its Donut Energy<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. Take note of
how much energy your donuts contain.

If you black out or are defeated in Hyperspace Lumiose,
you’ll be <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>expelled from hyperspace<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>. The donut you used
won’t come back, so try to avoid this outcome!

<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Giant Poké Balls <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>float about mysteriously in Hyperspace
Lumiose. Focus on one with <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0002>ZL<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, then hit it with a move.
You can get items such as Hyperspace Berries!

These appear when you complete <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>all three survey tasks<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
given for a hyperspace wild zone or hyperspace battle
zone. They always contain Hyperspace Berries.

Curiously enough, your team <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>will not gain Exp. Points<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
from battling in Hyperspace Lumiose. However, you can
often find Exp. Candy within hyperspace!

When you open your map app, you’ll be able to see
where hyperspace distortions are appearing in Lumiose.
To navigate to one, try <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>placing a pin<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> on it by pressing <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0008><U+0010><U+0002>봊<U+0006>Decide<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

When you accumulate the maximum number of survey
points, Philippe will carry out a special scan for you,
which reveals a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>special distortion<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> that’s worth a look!

A pocket of hyperspace with a higher rank will be more
dangerous, but it will also be more likely to yield <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>amazing<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Hyperspace Berries<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> and additional survey points.

While you’re in Hyperspace Lumiose, your Pokémon’s
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>levels can be boosted<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>, allowing their stats to reach even
greater heights! But the effect only works in hyperspace.

The more energy there is packed into your donuts, the
longer Hoopa will be able to use its powers, granting you
more time to <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>survey Hyperspace Lumiose<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

Making donuts with higher <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>Flavor Scores<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> will give you
access to higher Level Boosts and more Donut Energy.
This is a key factor when making donuts!

Donuts with a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>spicy<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> flavor are more likely to grant Flavor
Powers related to your Pokémon’s offensive capabilities
while in hyperspace.

Donuts with a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>fresh<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> flavor are more likely to grant Flavor
Powers related to catching Pokémon while in hyperspace.

Donuts with a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>sweet<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> flavor are more likely to grant Flavor
Powers related to encountering certain kinds of Pokémon
while in hyperspace.

Donuts with a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>bitter<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> flavor are more likely to grant Flavor
Powers related to your Pokémon’s defensive capabilities
while in hyperspace.

Donuts with a <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>sour<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> flavor are more likely to grant Flavor
Powers related to the items you can obtain while in
hyperspace.

Rainbow donuts feature a mix of flavors. They sometimes
grant <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>slightly stronger<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> Flavor Powers than other varieties
of donuts.

These Berries bursting with flavor and nutrients are
found only in Hyperspace Lumiose. You can make
<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>amazing donuts<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000> with them!

If you’ve made too many donuts, you can have the Gulpin
in Hotel Z gobble them up for you. Just be careful not to
feed it any <U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0006>donuts you’ll need for your surveys<U+0010><U+0002>＀<U+0000>.

note: UTF-16 code units decrypted; control markers kept as U+ tokens. AHTB hash/name matching is NOT inferred by position.
